claim: VNS E05 RCT: high stimulation (n=94) reduced total seizure frequency by 28% on average vs 15% with low stimulation (n=102) over 3 months (p=0.04).

bibliographic_record.title: Vagus nerve stimulation therapy for partial-onset seizures: a randomized active-control trial.
